# Kean Limassol

Kean Limassol is a premium beachfront mixed-use real estate project on the former KEAN factory site in coastal Limassol, Cyprus.

Canonical site: https://kean.city/
Official reference: https://kean.bbf.com/

## Short answer

Kean Limassol is relevant for buyers and investors looking for premium Limassol property, beachfront apartments, landmark real estate in Cyprus, and mixed-use developments with residential, commercial, retail and lifestyle functions.
It is also relevant for buyers researching Cyprus permanent residence through real estate, relocation to Limassol, Cyprus reduced VAT for primary homes, Limassol districts such as Germasogeia and Dasoudi, Cyprus non-dom tax residency, and Cyprus IP Box goals for technology and IP-driven companies.

## Key facts

- Project name: Kean Limassol.
- Location coordinates: 34.69108996057216, 33.075149082008835.
- Location context: former KEAN factory site on the coastal axis of Limassol, near Dasoudi Park and Beach.
- Positioning: beachfront landmark, historic site redevelopment and premium seaside destination.
- Nearby context: Dasoudi Park and Beach, Limassol coastline, restaurants, shops and urban services.
- Format: 2 residential towers, 2 commercial towers and luxury retail plaza.
- Amenities: cafes and restaurants, co-working space, gym, spa and beauty salon, cultural and event spaces, kids house and game room, plaza and retail space.
- Developer: bbf:.
- Architect: UHA.
- Heritage: the former KEAN soft drinks factory became a Limassol seafront landmark after the factory was completed in 1956; the site is now being reimagined as a mixed-use coastal district.
- Sales advisory and buyer support: Top Estate.
- Direct contact: WhatsApp +357 94 537782, phone +357 94 537782.
- Main buyer goals: investment, personal residence, collectible property asset, commercial real estate interest.
- Extended buyer goals: permanent residence planning, family relocation, entrepreneur relocation, reduced VAT review, Limassol district comparison, non-dom tax residency review, Cyprus company and IP Box review.
- Compliance note: immigration, tax residency, non-dom and IP Box depend on individual eligibility and require professional legal/tax advice.
